text: Hello Abbu, it's Ayesha. How are you feeling?
Just quiet, beta. The house feels very empty since your mother passed.
I'm sorry, Abbu. Have you been seeing friends?
Not really. Nobody visits much now. I feel lonely most days.
Not well. I wake at three in the morning and cannot sleep again. I have no appetite either.
I'm here with you. Would you like to tell me about old times?
Maybe. I just feel a bit low today, that's all. Nothing serious.
